requirements.description: Empty PostgreSQL reaches the sole Alembic head and explicit bootstrap is idempotent.
Post-bootstrap row, sequence, foreign-key, uniqueness, and revision checks pass.
Initial administrator exists and one-time bootstrap credentials are absent from runtime.
Registration, verification, login, refresh/revocation, reset, lockout, authorization, and logout pass.
Catalog sync fixtures, pricing, cart, shipping, upload boundaries, and order persistence pass.
Sandbox checkout, retries, signed/duplicate webhooks, refund, and reconciliation pass.
Verified sender delivers transactional mail to controlled recipients without secret disclosure.
Configured object storage upload, authorized retrieval, rejection, and cleanup pass.
Verified local and off-host backup restores twice and restored application boot meets approved RTO.
Effective container user, read-only root, capabilities, limits, networks, mounts, and secret separation pass.
Confirmed canonical URL passes TLS, proxy, CORS, CSRF, upload limits, redaction, and browser checks.
Availability, DB, container, capacity, backup, HTTP, and certificate alerts are exercised and routed.
Customer and administrator empty states and newly-created records render correctly.
